messages:
Maya: Quick copy check on the dashboard empty state when an org hits the monthly token cap. Current draft in Figma: • Title: "Quota exceeded" • Body: "Your organization has used all tokens for this billing cycle. Generations are disabled until the quota resets or you purchase more." • Primary button: "Upgrade" • Secondary link: "Docs: quotas" Feels abrupt. Looking for a friendlier tone and clearer action routing for both self-serve and enterprise customers. Ravi: +1. Main issue: "Upgrade" only fits self-serve. Enterprise customers on Dedicated may need to file a request. Also want to avoid words like "disabled" which sound dire. Tess: Frontend constraints: compact cards will use icon-only controls. Need accessible labels for those. Also prefer button text <= 18 chars for mobile. Maya: Draft option A (conservative): • Title: "Token limit reached" • Body: "You've reached your token allocation for this billing period. Generations are paused. You can request more tokens or wait for the next cycle." • Primary: "Request more tokens" • Secondary: "Quota docs" Maya: Rationale: softer verbs, explicit next steps. Eli: Accessibility notes: primary action should expose a clear aria-label like "Request more tokens — opens request form". The title should be announced (role="status" or aria-live) so screen readers catch it immediately. Also ensure the contrast for the secondary link meets AA. Noelle: Product: prefer "Request increase" over "Request more tokens" (shorter). Also want an inline microcopy: "Typical response time: 12 days" so customers set expectations. Maya: Okay iteration B (preferred): • Title: "Token limit reached" • Body: "You've reached your token allocation for this billing period. Generations are paused. – Request an increase to continue now – Or wait for the billing cycle to reset" • Primary: "Request increase" • Secondary: "How quotas work" • Inline note: "Typical response: 12 days" Tess: For mobile/compressed cells we can use the short label "Increase" on the icon-only button with aria-label="Request increase". That keeps layout tight but remains accessible. Eli: Confirming: use a list for the two options in the body so screen readers read each item. Also prefer aria-live="polite" for the body rather than role="status" for more consistent behavior. Maya: Example markup suggestion: ```html

Token limit reached

You've reached your token allocation for this billing period. Generations are paused.

  • Request an increase to continue now
  • Wait for the billing cycle to reset
How quotas work

Typical response: 12 days

``` Tess: I'll implement markup + the icon-only variant. Will keep visible text for >=768px, icon-only for <768px. Noelle: Can we add telemetry: event name = "quota_empty_primary_click" with attributes: {customer_tier, org_id, button_variant}? We want to know how often people request increases vs waiting. Ravi: +1. Also add a success/failure event for the request flow. Eli: For accessibility QA, I'll test with VoiceOver and NVDA once the PR is up. Please ensure focus moves to the primary button when the empty state appears. Maya: Final decision: go with iteration B copy above. Tess to open PR with aria-labels and responsive labels; Eli to run a11y check; Noelle to own analytics spec. Tess: PR opened: — tagging @Maya for copy sign-off. Maya: Approved. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Noelle: I'll add the analytics ticket to the sprint. Eli: Following up after a11y tests.
